summary: To log in over HTTP only (behind an HTTP load balancer or for troubleshooting), set SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = False and CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = False in /etc/tower/conf.d/custom.py and restart.
questions: Cannot log in to automation controller over HTTP
How do I disable secure cookies in automation controller?

answer_card.title: Log in over HTTP only
answer_card.answer_md:
In `/etc/tower/conf.d/custom.py`:
```python
SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = False
CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = False
```
Restart controller services. Use only behind an HTTP-only proxy or for troubleshooting.
